examples.en: Iron pens, authors that flow by. I am the pen—I can afford to wait. But you can't. You'll be replaced soon en…
examples.zh: 铁打的笔，流水的作者。我是笔，我不怕等，但你等不了。你很快就会被取代，好自为之。
